title: Best Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend
excerpt: August in the NC High Country means cool mountain air, packed event calendars, and one of the most beautiful landscapes in the Southeast. Whether you're visiting for the weekend or quietly thinking about making this place home, here's everything happening in Boone and the surrounding area right now.
